release_rule: All stages must pass on one coherent action/carrier/readout chain before merge to main.

action_policy.reason: The saved 100-cycle rest pass and strongest short-time movement pass use different research actions.

stages.summary: Exact localized rest solution rebuilt on the clean branch with only standard Lean foundations.

The exact 6/361 complete-frame action still fails on 16 physical launches. The first departure is 99.9999% Psi and, on the carrier, 96.365% is amplitude/phase along the already-correct Psi ray; the three-prong orientation-normal error is only 0.352%. The error grows to norm ratio 4.820 and shape error 4.654 over 100 cycles.
Fixed four-component phase-space readout with an explicit controlled complementary-sector remainder; exact zero finite-lattice remainder is not required.
Operational spin-half on the localized carrier.
Short-time Dirac transport and native current.
One complete cell crossing against the independent Dirac comparator at a solved crossing time; neither a one-update jump nor rigid fractional snapshots are required.
Second unreset crossing in both directions.
Same-state mass, time, transport, density, current, and phase map.
Axes, diagonal, separately measured copies, physically admissible perturbations, timestep, and box robustness.
Cumulative analytic Lean theorem plus separate reproducible numerical and clean-release audits.
